![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

The `@OptIn(ExperimentalStdlibApi::class)` annotation indicates the use of an experimental API (`HexFormat.UpperCase`). While this is an internal function, using experimental APIs in a production library can introduce instability if the API changes in future Kotlin versions. Consider if there's a stable alternative or if the risk is acceptable for this specific use case.

![low](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/low-priority.svg)

The import `kotlin.collections.isEmpty` is likely redundant. The `isEmpty()` extension function is available directly on `Collection` types without needing a specific import from `kotlin.collections`.

```suggestion
import kotlin.math.max
```
